clauses.V0: feeds xwoba_est vs Savant xwOBA on AAA same-season overlap (>= 25 BBE / >= 100 PA): Spearman >= 0.7 or STOP; report r, rho, bias, slope
clauses.M-A: PRIMARY: A-ball season pairs (Y in 2023-2025 -> Y+1, z within destination pool, >= 150 PA both legs, >= 25 tracked BBE in Y): blend50 of the xwoba_est-implied gap into the actual line must predict next-season wOBA better than the actual line; lo95 > 0
clauses.M-CPX: SECONDARY: same design at CPX; honest NULL closes it
clauses.AUX-1: hit p90 EV level-relative at A vs next-season wOBA z; lo95 > 0 or NULL
clauses.AUX-2: hit whiff/swing-miss (zone_metrics) at A vs next-season K% and wOBA z
clauses.AUX-3: pit fastball velo (feeds) at A vs next-season K% against
clauses.selection_bias: same-band covered vs uncovered next-season outcome gap + CI, mandatory per arm; big gap => confounded, do not ship
clauses.ship_rule: V0 + M-A pass -> feeds-based gap source in efv_statcast_line, W=0.5, caps .050/.050/.100, A/CPX 2023+, default-OFF flags, then the S-XLINE in-matrix clauses before any flip; AUX passes inform future registrations only

v0.note: feeds xwoba_est is the module's contact-only estimate (xwOBAcon scale, incl. its profile adjustment); Savant xwoba is full xwOBA (includes K/BB), so a level bias is expected and reported; the registered gate is the rank agreement (Spearman)
v0.v0_2025_leg: skipped - stored rows are 2026-only; AAA 2025 would be a ~2,200-feed backfill (registration: only 'without a huge fetch')

diagnostics_descriptive.note: descriptive ledger diagnostics; the registered gate statistic is the >= 25 BBE Spearman above
diagnostics_descriptive.reading: agreement does NOT rise with more BBE (structural, not noise); the feed estimate clears 0.70 against the contact-flavored Savant xSLG; the residual vs full xwOBA loads on Savant K% and BB% - i.e. the failure is the contact-only-vs-full-xwOBA quantity mismatch, not a broken EV/LA surface. A future registration would need a like-for-like V0 quantity (K/BB-completed reconstruction or xSLG-family gap) re-registered BEFORE any re-run; nothing proceeds in this one.

not_run_per_v0_stop.backfill: A (sport 14) + CPX (sport 16) hitter feeds 2023-2025 NOT fetched (registered scope, gated behind V0)

keep_alive: revival requires a NEW pre-registered V0 on a like-for-like quantity: either (a) complete the feeds estimate to full-xwOBA scale with the stat line's K/BB before comparing, or (b) gate on an xSLG-family agreement (measured 0.714 here, descriptive). The EV/LA surface itself looks usable; the registered proxy quantity was the wrong yardstick. No arm may be run under THIS registration.
verdict: V0 STOP - in-house feeds xwoba_est proxy below the 0.70 rank-agreement bar vs Savant xwOBA; no backfill run, arms not executed. This artifact is the V0 loss ledger.
